name: Footer
title: Footer
summary: The site-wide black footer for ism.bible: a gradient-bordered giving banner, the full ISM logo with tagline and socials, three link columns and a legal line.
whenToUse: Use it once, at the bottom of every ism.bible page and every page built from the website kit.
whenNotToUse: Do not use it in apps or email (email has its own footer).
Do not add page-specific links here. Put them in the page body or in a sitemap link list.

anatomy.description: Top to bottom: glow layer, CTA banner, brand column + three nav columns, hairline, legal row.

props.name: ctaText
props.description: Mission sentence in the giving banner.

props.name: ctaLabel
props.description: Label of the banner button (an outline button with ↗). Omit with `ctaHref` to hide the banner.

props.name: linkComponent
props.description:
Component used to render links. Defaults to `'a'`.
Pass `next/link` (or any component accepting `href`, `className` and `children`) for client-side routing.

props.name: logo
props.description: Logo slot. Defaults to an `` using `logoSrc`; the CSS inverts it to white.

props.name: logoSrc
props.description: Path of the default full logo.

props.name: logoAlt
props.description: Alt text of the default logo.

props.name: logoLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the logo link.

props.name: legal
props.description: Legal lines on the left: copyright, nonprofit notice. Each item becomes a paragraph.

props.name: legalLinks
props.description: Legal links on the right (Cookie Policy, Terms, Privacy).

props.name: cookieSettingsLabel
props.description: Label of the "Cookie settings" button. The button is omitted when this or `onCookieSettings` is missing.

props.name: onCookieSettings
props.description: Called when "Cookie settings" is pressed; it should reopen the cookie banner. It is a `<button>` because it opens a dialog.

props.name: compact
props.description: Force the phone layout (`.nv-foot-sm`). It also applies automatically below 768px.

props.name: legalExtra
props.description: Extra content rendered at the end of the legal row, for example an inline `LanguageInline`.

react.notes: `import { Footer } from '@ism/ui'`. Data-driven: it renders the same `.nv-foot` markup as the HTML below from `columns`, `socials` and `legal`. The component ships no copy: pass the banner, tagline, columns and legal text from Content below.

variantNotes: **Desktop:** 1100px max content width; brand column (max 390px) beside the three columns; legal row splits left/right.
**Mobile (below 768px, or `.nv-foot-sm`):** banner stacks with a full-width button, columns become a 2-up grid, legal links sit above the copyright.
**Link hover:** `.lnk` draws a 1px underline from the left.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Keep the footer `var(--black)` with the blue/peach glow; never put it on a light background.
The banner border is always `var(--gradient-line)` on a 1px transparent border, `var(--radius-ml)`. Do not fill it.
The banner button is `.btn-outline-light` with a white border and ↗ (it goes to another page). Never use a Horizon Blue primary here; the header already carries Give.
Column heads: 11px, 700, uppercase, `.13em` tracking, `var(--text-tertiary-dark)`. Links: 13px, 600, white.
Social links are 44px rings. Logo is white (`filter: brightness(0) invert(1)`), 285px wide max.
Legal text is 12px `var(--text-tertiary-dark)`; legal links and Cookie settings keep 44px tap height.
Only use ↗ on links that leave the page's context (the banner button); plain footer links get no icon.
do: Use it once, at the bottom of every ism.bible page and every page built from the website kit.

dont: Do not use it in apps or email (email has its own footer).

accessibility: Wrap the columns in `<nav aria-label="Footer">`. Column heads are headings so screen-reader users can jump between them.
Social icons are `aria-hidden`; each link has `aria-label` with the network's name.
"Cookie settings" is a `<button>`, not a link, because it opens a dialog.
White on black and 50% white on black both pass AA at the sizes used.
content: Banner: one plain sentence about the mission plus a short action. Example: "Help deliver the Bible beyond every barrier." / "Support Bible Access ↗".
Tagline stays as written: "Delivering unhindered access to the Bible until everyone can engage with Scripture in their own language, without barriers."

Columns: About (About ISM, Our Mission, Our Team, Statement of Faith, FAQ's), Platforms (dot.Bible App, ISM Radio, ISM Publishing, TAP Cards, Global Bible Network), Get Involved (Give Online, Join The Mission, Partner With Us, Newsletter, Contact).
